title: fleet-write: `issue_create` and `issue_patch` carry no issue `type`, so the triage seat cannot set Bug/Feature/Task through the only write path it may use
body:
Path: fleet decision — triage types every card at first grade (#7947, maintainer ruling 2026-08-12) | 缺项 | none

Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` (the `issue_create` and `issue_patch` rows) and the `issue-create` / `label-write` doors that build their actions ⇒ `domain:skills`; rationale: a duty in `triage-duties.md` has no write path.

Unblocks: `triage-duties.md` line 55 (the `type` is triage's fixed output, and triage is its only authoritative producer) and #7947's Bug-first tiebreaker in ordinary-queue selection, which can only rank cards that carry a type.

## The disconnect

- **The rule.** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` lines 55–58 say:
  - `type` (Bug/Feature/Task) is triage's fixed output;
  - a filer may pre-fill it and triage corrects it;
  - new cards are typed at once, and existing cards when next touched.
- **The write path.** Seats write only through the fleet-write relay. On `main` (`cab6396715`), `issue_patch` accepts `title`, `body`, `state` and `state_reason`, and `issue_create` accepts `title`, `body`, `labels` and `assignees`. The op table is closed, so a `type` key is refused, and no other op sets a type.
- **The result.** The relay landed in #19725 (2026-09-22). Since then no card has been typed. A sample of this session's grades and today's filings (#21867, #21880, #21885, #21898, #21899, #21903, #21909, #21910 and objectui#11660) all read `type: none`. The repository does have issue types: #18000, filed before the relay, carries `Bug`.

**This amends my practice.** Since the relay landed, my first grades have carried no type. I did not record that the rule could not be executed. It is recorded here and on the round record.

## Done when

- `issue_patch` and `issue_create` accept an optional `type`, limited to the repository's issue-type names (Bug, Feature, Task). An unknown name is refused before dispatch, not by the platform afterwards.
- A door carries it, either a `--type` on `label-write` / `issue-create` or a small `issue-type` door, and its read-back confirms the type the platform now serves.
- A self-test row covers each accepted name and the refused unknown name.

⛔ No backfill run across the backlog. Line 58 keeps "existing cards when next touched".

Dedupe: `mcp__github__search_issues` (objectstack-ai/objectstack, semantic, closed included), "issue type Bug Feature Task triage fixed output relay fleet-write cannot set issue type". The only typing hit is #7947 (closed, the ruling itself). #19884 (closed) is the same family of a missing relay op (`transfer`).
